exposure: trial of labor after cesarean section (TOLAC)
previous caesarean section indication (dystocia, failed induction)
finding: Previous vaginal delivery, previous cesarean indication, and Bishop score at admission were significant predictors of successful vaginal birth after cesarean, while induction of labor did not significantly impact success rate after adjusting for confounding variables.
mod_finding: The study found no significant difference in vaginal delivery rates between women who had a spontaneous labor and those who were induced.
